dj.line:
A dynamic-fee flag set at 0x800000 — the house keeps its hand on the rake while you're still holding cards. Somebody built a table where the price of sitting down changes after you've sat.

You think you'll notice the moment the rake moves — or just the moment your stack doesn't add up?
